finalText:
It builds clean now, 0 errors.

Two real bugs were hiding in that wall of noise. `resolveRetries` was still reading `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler renames that field to `retryCount`, so it crashed on `undefined`. Right after that, `isBackoffEnabled` treated any non-boolean flag as an error, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so it also crashed. Fixed both to match the new shapes.

The rest really was noise: deprecation notices and dedupe logs from the bump itself, nothing broken there.
